name: East Jordan Plastics
old_description: It all started four generations ago when Ken and Shirley Diller founded East Jordan Box and Crate Co. to produce wooden greenhouse flats for bedding plant growers in the Midwest. From those wooden flats to today’s comprehensive line of sustainable plastic plant containers, East Jordan Plastics remains committed to the only industry it has ever served—horticulture.
about:
East Jordan Plastics operates from East Jordan, Michigan, where it was founded four generations ago by Ken and Shirley Diller as East Jordan Box and Crate Co. The business began by producing wooden greenhouse flats for bedding plant growers in the Midwest and has remained in the family ever since.

Today the company manufactures a comprehensive line of sustainable plastic plant containers for greenhouses and nurseries. Its injection-molded product families include the SHUTTLE™ series of pots, hanging baskets, planters and bowls; the patented SHUTTLE POT® STADIUM® line of grower pots and trays with offset-printable flat sides; and a range of trays, carriers, flats, inserts, and plug and propagation trays precision-engineered for automated destacking, filling, transplanting and transport equipment. A closed-loop recycling program, certified for Post-Consumer Recycled (PCR) plastic by AM Testing, feeds reclaimed material back into production.

The company serves only the horticultural market—greenhouse growers, nursery operators, bedding plant producers and retail garden centers. Customers such as Bradford Greenhouses and Linwell Gardens use the containers for propagation, automated production and finished goods, citing space savings and labeling advantages from the STADIUM line.

East Jordan Plastics says its differentiation rests on four pillars: a closed-loop recycling system with third-party PCR certification, product designs tailored for high-speed automation, precision tooling that holds exact tolerances for plug trays, and a family-owned structure that has kept the focus on horticulture for nearly 80 years.
